name: Amazon Trip Around the Blox
desc:
📢Hi Everyone! We have an important announcement:

This experience will be ending on 30-12-22, meaning this is your last chance to score an Amazon box head!

Thank you all for playing 🧡. We hope the delightful memories created here will be treasured forever. Or at least until next time!

Join Fox and the forest animals as they drive out of our Holiday Kids Gift
Book and into Amazon Trip Around the Blox! Gather round and compete
against your friends in fun new mini games inspired by each animal.
Complete quests to earn ⭐ to unlock items!

📅 Check in daily to complete quests for each animal
👓 Earn coins to redeem items and dress up your avatar
🎁 FREE ITEM - Play 3 FULL ROUNDS of minigames to get the AMAZON BOX!
